summary.text: Tucker Colvin is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Curtis Schomer.
A water and wastewater operator, he named affordability, public safety and education as key campaign messages in a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Tucker Colvin earned a bachelor's degree from Montana State University and a graduate degree from the University of New Mexico.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as born and raised in Montana and currently working as a water and wastewater operator with rural and tribal utilities in Montana and surrounding states, providing training and technical assistance.
He said he has also held jobs in agriculture and at food banks.

Colvin's survey responses emphasized affordability, including housing, child care, health care and taxes; public safety through prevention-focused approaches; and investment in education from early childhood through apprenticeship and college programs.
